page.layout: One printed page, one column of verse with a centred subheading. Running head at top. Page number top left. Catchword absent. A short line at bottom right of the text (signature-like catchword "Vix") sits at the right below the last line.

main_text.p:
Infames Sodomæ domos
Pœna mitior, omni
Cum gente, prisco
Perdidit ævo.

Nam dicto citius simul
Cœlitus periere
Flammæ furentis
Turbine misso.

Sed gens cladibus, heu, suis
Abrameaa superstes
Totum per orbem
Sparsa gemiscit.
main_text.head: ZAIIM. HETH. TETH.
main_text.p:
QVEIS maior ante dignitas fuit per urbem
Syonis, & niue qui fuere puriores:
Queis latte quouis dulcior per omne corpus
Fuit venustas fusa, queis genasque pinxit
Decor smaragdis pulchrior, gemmisque cunctis:
Nunc omnis illa forma concidit recisa:
Nunc omnis illa turba decolor camino
Vultus gerit suliginoso nigriores
Mutata nemo novit ora, quum per urbis
Exangue corpus vix trahit misella vicos.

page.notes: Heading "Zaiim. Heth. Teth." is a Hebrew-letter acrostic label, transcribed as printed in Latin letters because the printed heading is Latin-letter. Verse lines are set in italic throughout; italic marking omitted in the text above for those verses, reproduced as plain text where the scan is uncertain. Probable doubtful readings: "Abrameaa" (printed as shown; likely "Abramea"), "Abrameaa superstes" line, "Turbine misso" (last letter may be a Cyrillic-looking o; check), "suliginoso" (printed "fuliginoso" likely), "Vix" at lower right is a catchword. Several words in the verse lines are only partly legible (for example "Queis latte", "Nunc omnis illa forma"); these are transcribed as best read. Marginal ghost text from the reverse side (show-through) is ignored. The first two verse blocks at top are italic; the "Ponere membra." line is italic.
